rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for repetition or a repeated instance in general.

example.english: There is some repetition in this report, and it gets a bit boring.
example.traditional: 呢份報告有幾段內容重複咗，睇落有啲悶。
example.jyutping: ne1 fan6 bou3 gou3 jau5 gei2 dyun6 noi6 jung4 cung4 fuk1 zo2 tai2 lok6 jau5 di1 mun6

rows.note: Use this exercise-counting construction for the number of times a controlled movement is performed.

example.english: One repetition of this exercise is enough.
example.traditional: 呢個動作做一下就夠喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 dung6 zok3 zou6 jat1 haa5 zau6 gau3 laa3
